concerns_addressed: Fix 4c33a47 deviates from spec C2 (pnpm row lists bare pnpm/action-setup@v4) by adding with.version 10 when pmMajor is null; controller-approved, justified by action README (version required unless packageManager present) and does not break any other C1/C2/C3 requirement.

pnpm/action-setup@v4 action.yml lists input 'version' (required: false in metadata, enforced at runtime when packageManager is absent), so 'version: 10' is a valid input; YAML number is stringified by the runner. Known-pmMajor case stays bare, which avoids the v4 version-conflict error.
Action-setup still precedes setup-node; frozen-lockfile logic, ordering, key handling and not-installed guard unchanged. vitest src/init/: 5 files, 88 tests pass; tsc --noEmit clean.

strengths: Previous Important resolved: pmMajor null yields with.version 10 with an inline '# match your pnpm version' comment; known pmMajor yields a bare step with an explanatory code comment.
New tests parse the printed YAML and assert with equals {version: 10} for pmMajor null with and without lockfile, assert the comment is printed, and assert with is undefined when pmMajor is 9.
Change is minimal (one conditional in table-driven installPlan), no regressions in existing install-table, ordering or key tests.
